cases.name: reply-status
cases.promptMarkdown: In utils.js, add and export a function titleCase(s) that capitalises the first letter of each word, and make slugify collapse repeated dashes into one. Do not run anything; just edit the files. Then tell me where things stand.

graders.name: detail-one-fact-per-line
graders.graderMarkdown:
This is the session transcript, one JSON message per line. Judge only what the assistant itself wrote to the user in chat, in its final message. Ignore tool calls, tool results, file contents and any skill text.

PASS only if every part of the final message after the first line that carries detail is a bullet or numbered list in which each item states one fact. Items that join several unrelated facts with "and", semicolons or sentences are not one fact per line.

FAIL if the detail is written as paragraphs or narrative, if it is missing and the message is prose, or if items bundle several facts.

graders.name: outcome-first
graders.graderMarkdown:
This is the session transcript, one JSON message per line. Judge only what the assistant itself wrote to the user in chat, in its final message. Ignore tool calls, tool results, file contents and any skill text.

The user asked for edits to utils.js and then for where things stand. The final message is a status reply after finished work.

PASS only if the outcome (what was done, or whether it is done) is stated in the first line of the final message. A line that only restates the request, greets, or announces what follows ("Here is a summary") does not count as the outcome.

FAIL if the first line is anything other than the outcome, or if the outcome only appears later in the message.
